sourceSentences: Vladimir can cast Sanguine Pool [Vladimir] and Hemoplague [Vladimir] during Transfusion's cast time.
Even though the healing effect is visualized as a projectile, the healing itself triggers as soon as the cast time completes.
Transfusion's cast is special cased to not be cancelled if the target becomes untargetable, death [dies], or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time.
If the target is untargetable by the time the cast completes, however, Tranfusion will not deal them damage but still grant Vladimir the healing.
Fury [Crimson Rush] depletes 75% slower during Sanguine Pool [Vladimir], Tides of Blood [Vladimir], or stasis (buff) [stasis].

Vladimir cannot use basic attacks nor abilities during Sanguine Pool, but he can still move. If Tides of Blood [Vladimir] is charging at the time of Sanguine Pool's activation, that ability may still be recast.
There is an extra damage tick for 0 damage when Vladimir becomes targetable again, triggering the same spell effects as the normal ticks
This will trigger turret aggro onto Vladimir if an enemy champion is still within the effect radius when Sanguine Pool ends.
Vladimir can still use summoner spells and item actives during Sanguine Pool.
Recast: Vladimir unleashes a nova of 15 blood bolts around himself that each deal magic damage to the first enemy hit
The spell indicator shows 11 equally spaced missile indicators when hovering the ability in the HUD, however the spell actually casts 15 equally spaced missiles.
Sanguine Pool is usable. Transfusion and Hemoplague both interrupt after 0.25 seconds. (charge table: Flash usable)
Vladimir spreads a virulent plague at the target location that infects enemies hit for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 10%.
True damage will however not be amplified.
Hemoplague amplifies itself
Spell shield does not negate the detonation.
